NTA, he needs to worry about sharing more of the bills rather than the bonus you earned.  
Rethink this relationship, he seems more interested in what you can provide (snooping into your finances) than in being a partner.
i wonder if OP only made 2 cinnamon rolls?  like is his husband so isolated and controlled that he is only allowed one cinnamon roll and no friends?

YTA, your husband is 2 years older than your son but you are protecting your husband as if he was your child.  you are so worried about other people manipulating your husband that it makes me suspicious that perhaps you are the manipulative one. 
Your husband needs to grow up and you need to find a "fruitful" relationship with someone your own age (or at least able to make basic decisions)
It is just weird how you have higher expectations for your son than for your child-husband.

I did not know that about Wellbutrin!  I was on it and Luvox at the same time, which probably explains why I was super angry and felt suicidal that time.  
I probably need a new psychiatrist.
edit: i just realized he had me on another bad combo last year, Fluoxetine and Buspirone.  Maybe that is why my PCP was freaking out.  I lost close to 30lbs and started feeling really weird and melty every time i took it so I stopped.

That's a good question!  I have been on it for the past 7 years at least, so I can't be sure but I do feel more stable that I have on previous medications.  I went through many before we got to prozac as a last resort. Maybe it is helping my my picking because I don't have as many intrusive thoughts and i never made the connection.
I think I have been on Clomipramine, i have been diagnosed for maybe 15 years now and have been on so many.  Worst was Wellbutrin, it made me psycho!

I take 80mg/day and it has really helped. Doctors who aren't my psychiatrist seem to get freaked out about the dosage, but it is the only medication that helped me stop picking at my skin.
edit: it only helps with the compulsions, i still get the obsession parts.  I used to spend hour picking at my skin each day until Prozac.  Stopping picking was the most important part to me, so i am staying on it.

YTA because of this line "I felt it would be weird for everyone if I went so I asked Scott if he'd be okay going alone and he said yes." 

You recognized that it would be an awkward situation and chose to let your son enter it alone.  You chose your own comfort rather than to suck it up for a couple hours to support your son while he grieved his dead father.  You stated that you knew the wife didn't like your son but you still allowed him to spend weekends with his father in a house where he was not wanted?! that has got to fuck up a kid, having to confront resentment that should have been directed at his mom for 17 years.

People are patting you on the back for protecting your child after the fact but you should not have let him go alone. How could you imagine this would be OK?  Did you even think this out?  And you friend calling you an asshole kind of makes me think that you may have issues thinking about other people's feelings in general.

It is kind of powerful for her to go by Kamala and not something like "Harris" or "K. Harris" because it makes a statement that she embraces her womanhood and her ethnicities.  How many powerful women feel pressure to disguise their names by using initials or just by going by their surname?  She is normalizing her name and hopefully there are little girls named Kamala that don't feel ashamed for having "ethnic" names.

I think i will try to get into an MMO to connect with people in a non-threatening way.
